design: One unified distribution heatmap. One equal-size strip per observed execution.
within_group_order: Ascending measured deviation, not chronological order.
missing: Grey strips are missing/unavailable results, not zero deviations.
x_axis: Equally spaced categorical columns for tested settings; no interpolation.
normalization: Mean power relative to the variant-specific 600-s group median.

source.duration_selection: One PicoScope result per physical execution after deduplicating comparator rows.
source.rate_selection: Exact series/window in direct_rates.csv; sensor=pico; included=True; finite energy_J and span_s.
source.validation: Unique executions, published group sizes, duration medians, rate-group mean energies and equal-group-weight references verified.
